name: xflickr_quota_exhausted

query_condition.sql: SELECT key_id FROM "{{OPENOBSERVE_STREAM}}" WHERE event='crawl.health.key' AND "limit" > 0 AND remaining <= 0 GROUP BY key_id

description: Impact: A Flickr API key has exhausted its hourly quota of granted calls. Action: Check key rotation and pending work; calls will pause until reset.
